Staff Integration Engineer (Security Platform and Data Pipelines)
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
Role
We are looking for a Staff Integration Engineer (Security Platform and Data Pipelines) to join our team. This is a remote based in India role, reporting to the Director, Software Development Engineering in the Technical Implementation and Integration department. You will be responsible for connecting and onboarding diverse cybersecurity data sources, mapping and normalizing security data to power exposure and threat management use cases, and customizing workflows to deliver measurable outcomes. This role requires technical depth, comfort with complex datasets, and the ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
What you’ll do (Role Expectations)
- • Build and update data mappings for exposure management sources from research specs. This covers vulnerability scanners (Qualys, Tenable, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike), cloud security (Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Orca), application security (Snyk, AI scanners), device management (Microsoft Intune) and CMDB (ServiceNow). Test every change against raw customer data before it ships
- • Investigate customer environments where data looks wrong or incomplete: missing fields, duplicate or stale vulnerabilities, one device showing up as several assets, or counts that don't match the vendor's console. Trace each one to its root cause in the raw data and ship the fix
- • Compare vendor APIs and endpoints to pick the right source for each use case, and flag gaps and quirks back to the research team
- • Support customer onboarding and proofs of value: get the customer's tools connected, check that the data that lands is accurate and complete, and fix what isn't
- • Write clear root-cause notes and handoffs for researchers, engineering and customer-facing teams, and turn recurring issues into product fixes
Who You Are (Success Profile)
- • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
- • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
- • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
- • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
- • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.
What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)
- • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
- • 5 to 8 years experience in security engineering with hands-on experience integrating security tools into a data platform such as a SIEM, vulnerability management or exposure management product. You've mapped or normalized data from at least two of these: vulnerability scanners, EDR, cloud security (CNAPP/CSPM), application security scanners and CMDB
- • Working knowledge of vulnerability and exposure data: what a scanner reports about assets, vulnerabilities and misconfigurations, how CVEs relate to vendor IDs and plugins, how one machine appears across tools (hostnames, IPs, cloud and agent IDs), and what CVSS and EPSS mean
- • Strong Python and SQL. You can read a raw API response, write the transformation, query large datasets to check the result and debug a data issue end to end
- • Comfort with vendor APIs: reading their docs, handling authentication, pagination and rate limits, and finding the field a use case needs
What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)
- • Experience leveraging AI-assisted developer tools, automated profiling, or AI acceleration libraries to speed up mapping, testing or investigation
- • API-level experience with any of the vendors above
- • Application security knowledge: what SAST, SCA and container scanners find, and how their results tie to code, packages and images
